description: This Java class `GccMapReader` is a utility to parse and print information from GCC linked .map files, extracting symbol sizes and addresses, and providing a sorted report.
external_files: java.io.*, java.util.ArrayList, java.util.Collections, java.util.Comparator, java.util.List, java.util.regex.Matcher, java.util.regex.Pattern

classes.name: GccMapReader
classes.description: Main utility class that reads, processes, and displays symbol size information from a GCC map file.

classes.name: GccMapReader.Record
classes.description: Inner class representing a symbol with size and name, comparable based on size and name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads the filename argument, loads the file, processes the lines to extract records, sorts them, and prints symbol information along with total size.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the list of lines from the map file to extract symbol records related to '.bss' sections.

methods.name: parseMultiLine
methods.description: Handles multi-line symbol entries in the map file, extracting size and name information.

methods.name: parseSingleLine
methods.description: Handles single-line symbol entries, extracting size and name information.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Utility method for debug printing (currently disabled).
